caption:
guilt is not a retention feature

#wellness #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
Streaks measure showing up

Not beating yesterday

Mine says 3 days

Days I did something,
not days I was perfect

Break it for a life reason

Start again on Tuesday

No lecture waiting

An app should hold the record

Not hold it against you

slides.heading: Kept, not weaponised
slides.body: SOMA's streak counts the days you showed up for your body — and starts fresh without shame when life happens
